decisions.reason: Launched only last year with its own product page, the resin injection unit's value is still uncertain and keeping it listed costs little, so the option stays open.
This second resin injection variant has only a single year of presence and no evidence of failure, so it is too early to abandon what is a cheap option.
The automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's core coating equipment line, and with uncertainty unresolved after one year, holding the option is low-cost.
The manual airless spray gun is a core-adjacent product with low carrying cost, and the first-year results do not reveal enough to justify dropping it.
The air-assisted airless gun complements the spray gun range, and its prospects remain uncertain, so keeping the option open is sensible.
The data logger is a digital add-on with uncertain but potentially growing value, and it is cheap to keep listed while that value resolves.
